WITH mg_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_date,
    c.customer_city,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-03-01' THEN 'baseline'
      WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-03-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01' THEN 'window'
    END AS period
  FROM orders.orders AS o
  JOIN orders.customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'MG'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-02-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01'
),
mg_payments AS (
  SELECT
    mo.order_id,
    mo.order_date,
    mo.customer_city,
    mo.period,
    pp.payment_type
  FROM mg_orders AS mo
  JOIN payments.order_payments AS pp ON pp.order_id = mo.order_id
),
city_stats AS (
  SELECT
    customer_city,
    period,
    COUNT(*) AS n_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'boleto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_boleto,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'boleto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*), 4) AS boleto_share
  FROM mg_payments
  GROUP BY customer_city, period
),
city_pivot AS (
  SELECT
    customer_city,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN boleto_share END) AS value,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN boleto_share END) AS baseline,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN n_payments END) AS n_window,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN n_payments END) AS n_baseline,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN n_boleto END) AS boleto_window,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN n_boleto END) AS boleto_baseline
  FROM city_stats
  GROUP BY customer_city
)
SELECT
  customer_city,
  ROUND(value, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(baseline, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(value - baseline, 4) AS share_diff,
  n_window,
  n_baseline,
  boleto_window,
  boleto_baseline
FROM city_pivot
WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND baseline IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(value - baseline) * n_window DESC, n_window DESC
LIMIT 20;
